name: router-lever
description: /router switches claude-router between rules, Anthropic and the router's downstreams for this session; /router <downstream> [tier] window|model <value> sets this session's settings line, /router <downstream> reset clears it; /router name labels the session in the console; Claude can switch and set both too (router_lever tool), gated by the typed commands; the status line shows the mode.
